brief:
NGOs and mutual aid groups report tens of thousands of tents sit unused in warehouses outside Gaza as Israeli restrictions prevent their entry, according to Middle East Eye. The groups characterize the winter conditions as a "manufactured crisis" accelerated by Israeli policy rather than an unavoidable seasonal hardship.

Israeli authorities have limited the flow of aid materials into the territory, leaving displaced Palestinians without adequate shelter as temperatures drop.

title: Israeli restrictions worsen Gaza winter crisis, NGOs say
